Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — SOC2 / questionnaire / access

Hi Tom — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and asks so we have a single thread: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: you mentioned Helix has a current SOC 2 Type II for 2025 — can you confirm whether the full report PDF is shareable with vendors (external access) or whether you require an NDA/POA? If shareable, please attach the PDF. If not, a provisional attestation or "interim" statement that we can rely on is fine for procurement while we complete onboarding.

2) Vendor security questionnaire (attached): you offered to send over the questionnaire output from your portal. Please attach the master questionnaire or your exported spreadsheet so we can pre-populate answers.

3) Trust portal / artifact access: to speed evaluation, would you provide read-only access to your Trust portal (preferred) or a secure SFTP/Share link to the artifacts (SOC2, control evidence, config screenshots). If portal access requires an internal request, please advise the right contact.

4) Timeline: our procurement/security typically needs the SOC2 PDF (or attestation) + completed questionnaire to clear procurement. If we can get those in ~10 business days we can keep this in the same quarter.

I attached short demo notes and the questionnaire export you referenced. Next step: if you can share who on your side will own artifact access, I will loop in our security team for a quick intake.

Thanks —

Thanks for the forward — quick intake from security: 

Checklist we need to clear procurement for a pilot: 
- SOC2 Type II report PDF (preferred) OR a signed provisional attestation (signed by InfoSec leadership) that enumerates scope and last audit date.
- Completed vendor questionnaire (they already sent export; we need any references where they answered "see artifact" to actually point to the artifact).
- Evidence for high-risk controls: user access reviews (past 3 months), encryption-at-rest config screenshot, incident response testing summary (table-of-contents level ok).
- Evidence access: read-only TrustLocker link (time-limited) is ideal; fallback SFTP with S3-styled bucket + file manifest is acceptable.

If legal approval is required to share the PDF, the provisional attestation + selected artifacts above is typically sufficient for our procurement to sign a 90-day pilot NDA.

Estimate: with their cooperation (portal creds or SFTP + questionnaire clarifications) we can complete our review in 7 business days. If they require legal review on their end to share the PDF, add 3–5 business days.

Action items for me: once you get TrustLocker link / SFTP details or the attestation, I'll run a targeted evidence scan and return a short checklist for procurement.

-Kim
